senses.gloss: (Paʿpel of דרג, cmp. זרק; v. Fl. in Levy Talm. Dict. I, 444ᵃ) to drip.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 17b:3">Keth. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ משחא וכ׳</he> he dripped oil on the head of scholars at his son’s wedding.
<cite ref="Ketubot 17b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>דַּרְדּוּגֵי משחא וכ׳</he> the act of dripping oil &c. (indicating that the bride is a virgin).
